prompts.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL Councillion game asset: a 2 by 2 animation sprite sheet of ONE small friendly PUFFERFISH COURT HOST, transparent background. The reference image is STYLE ONLY: match the squid sprite's chunky pixel clusters, dark navy outline, ivory square eyes, limited flat color ramps, simple readable silhouette. Same 48x48 logical-pixel puffer character, same scale and perfectly centered identical position in all four equal square cells, big empty transparent gutter. Warm gold body with short spines and navy judge vest, small cue card. Top left neutral smiling; top right blink; bottom left enthusiastically raising one fin toward the board; bottom right making a small gavel tap. No environment, typography, logos, UI, smooth painting, realistic shading, extra characters, extra accessories. Each pose readable at 80px rendered size. Output square transparent PNG sprite atlas.

Create a NEW ORIGINAL camera-angle background for Councillion's underwater pixel-art team game, matching reference image's exact chunky pixel clusters, navy/teal stone and warm gold lamps. This is a medium close-up of ONE team's stone counsel bench in the SAME sunken courtroom, as if camera cut from wide stage to that team. Wide 16:9 landscape. Bench tabletop stretches across the lower quarter of the image, perfectly horizontal flat top at 70% height, empty space from 25% to 70% for five separately rendered game characters. One stone column and warm brass lantern on left, underwater window with tiny fish silhouettes on right, distant courtroom arches and legal books behind. Warm inviting blue/cyan water with restrained tiny gold details. No characters, text, labels, numbers, UI, logos, photorealistic texture or glossy 3D. Crisp limited-palette 16-bit GAME BACKGROUND, substantial large pixel shapes with modest texture. Composition primarily readable empty blue space over the bench. Original art, not a TV set replica.

Create a NEW ORIGINAL finale camera-angle backdrop for Councillion's underwater pixel-art court game, using reference image as STYLE AND LOCATION reference. Wide 16:9 landscape. Camera moves toward a central low winner's dais, a SINGLE wide flat stone plinth along bottom at 78% image height with room for five separately rendered characters. Two side columns and a high arch topped by subtle brass scales of justice; warm gold lanterns and small gold coral glints, teal water, distant tiny fish silhouettes, a few legal books and underwater flora at the edges. Central upper two thirds remain calm dark blue empty negative space for separately rendered winner text. Same chunky pixel clusters and hand-crafted 16-bit game texture as reference; not realistic, no elaborate fantasy paintings, no bloom. Celebratory warm lighting, still obviously underwater. No characters, UI, text, emblems, logos, confetti or trophies painted into background. Keep geometry clear and usable as game stage.
